title: feat(ui): one Personalized marker beside the list title holds the one reset to the view
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbJXD4Zm2YJkpU7fqLKKwUzp)_

Fixes #28950

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：列表与视图不一致时，标题旁出现一个「已个性化」标记；点开列出哪里不同（筛选、搜索、排序、分组、列布局、隐藏字段、行高、布局、行颜色、行号、行内编辑），并给出唯一的「恢复为视图设置」。页头 ⋯ 里的「重置视图」和 Display 面板的「恢复视图默认设置」去掉；排序弹层的重置和筛选面板的「全部清除」保留。
- **为什么改**：原来有两个重置入口，各管一部分，而且刷新或打开链接后 `uf_*` 参数会把旧列表带回来，搜索词也会从缓存回填。读者看不出列表被改过，也找不到一个能彻底恢复的地方。
- **风险与回滚**：只加不删：`ListView` 多一个可选宿主属性 `onPersonalizationChange`，i18n 多一组键，没有元数据键或选项。未传该属性的宿主（InterfaceListPage、ObjectDataPage、嵌入列表）保留原来的 Display 重置。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListUrlState.ts`（`handleResetView` 与 `withoutListStateParams`：清存储、清搜索缓存、剥离整组 `uf_*`）、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（各部分与视图的比对）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ListPersonalizedMarker.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm` 打开 Accounts 列表，按名称倒序并搜索 `a`：标题旁出现「已个性化」；点开看到「搜索」「排序」，点「恢复为视图设置」：列表回到视图排序、搜索清空、地址栏不再有 `uf_*`，刷新后仍然干净，标记消失。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

While a reader's list differs from its view, the Console draws one **Personalized** marker beside the list title. Opening it names what differs and holds the one **Reset to view**, with a sentence saying what it covers and what it leaves alone. The marker is not configurable: no metadata key and no option reach it.

- `ListView` (`@object-ui/plugin-list`): one new optional host prop, `onPersonalizationChange(parts)`. It reports, on change, which parts of the list on screen differ from the view: `sort`, `filters` (panel conditions, user-filter chips, the queue toggle), `search`, `grouping`, `hiddenFields`, `density`, `layout`, `rowColor`, `rowNumbers`, `inlineEdit`. The callback is read through a ref (AGENTS.md #10), and the report is keyed on the joined part list, so it fires only when the set changes. With the prop wired, the Display popover draws no reset of its own (`onReset` is left undefined; `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` is untouched). `viewDefaults` also accepts `grouping`, the view's own grouping under one the host laid over it; without that key, the grouping the list opened with counts as the view's.
- `ListPersonalizedMarker.tsx` (new, app-shell): an outline pill with a popover. Below `sm` it is the icon alone, named by its `aria-label`, so it never pushes the view name out. Each part label is a literal i18n key.
- `objectViewListUrlState.ts`: the reset now drops the view's stored entry, clears the cached search term, and strips the whole `uf_*` family from the address (`uf__filter`, `uf__search`, `uf__sort`, `uf__group` and every `uf_<field>` chip) through the new `withoutListStateParams`. A pending-reset flag makes the next seed read storage, not the URL, so a reload or an opened link cannot bring the old list back. The host adds `columns` to the parts when the stored entry carries a column state.
- `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`: the marker sits in the existing PageHeader `badge` slot (both header faces) and beside the phone title. `PageHeader.tsx` is not edited.
- `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, `objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`: the ⋯ entry "Reset view" and the folded bar's `object_view_reset_view` action are gone; ⋯ keeps favorites and is drawn only when favorites are.
- i18n, all ten packs: new `console.objectView.personalized`, `personalizedHeading` and `personalizedParts.*`; `resetView` and `resetViewTitle` are reworded to label the marker's reset and say everything it covers. No key is removed.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, the list personalization paragraph.
- Changeset `.changeset/28950-list-personalized-marker.md`, patch on plugin-list, app-shell and i18n.

## Why

Measured on main a4015ab4 before the change (code reading):

- The header ⋯ "Reset view" was offered only while a stored entry existed. It dropped the entry and remounted the list, but it left the search term (re-seeded from the search cache as `uf__search`) and the `uf_<field>` chips. After a reload or an opened link it left everything the URL carried, because the remount re-seeded sort, filters, search and grouping from the same `uf_*` params. A reader who changed only search, grouping, chips or a Display setting was never offered it.
- The Display popover's "Reset to view default" restored the Display settings only.

So a reader had two partial resets and no sign the list was theirs. The card asks for one marker and one whole reset.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.personalization-28950.test.tsx` (new, 12): nothing reported on the view's own list; sort compared against `viewDefaults`; search and filters; an incomplete filter row is not a filter; grouping against `viewDefaults` plus its control; hidden fields and density; a row-numbers toggle reported and then reverted; typed search; no Display reset when the callback is wired, kept without it (control); the sort popover's own reset stays.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listPersonalized-28950.test.tsx` (new, 5): `withoutListStateParams` strips the family and keeps `filter[owner]`; the marker shows only while parts are reported and ⋯ has no reset; after a reload the reset leaves no `uf_*` param, keeps `filter[owner]`, and the list opens with no search, filters or chips and the view's sort; in session the reset clears the cached search; a stored column state alone draws the marker and the reset clears it (control).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx`: its ⋯ "Reset view" pins move to the marker.

Ablations (each restored, tree byte-identical to HEAD):
- Removing `&& !reset` from the seed condition turns the reload test red (1 of 5 failed).
- Making the Display `onReset` unconditional turns the "no Display reset" test red (1 of 12 failed).

## Acceptance notes

- **Entries removed:** the header ⋯ "Reset view" (both header faces). The Display popover's whole-Display reset is hidden on the Console list, where the marker carries the reset; hosts that do not wire `onPersonalizationChange` keep it.
- **Per-control resets kept:** the sort popover's reset and the Filter panel's "Clear all".
- **Not touched by the reset, by design:** the record-open preference, pinned views and their order, favorites, a "View all" link's `filter[...]` scope, and the gallery card size (an object-wide setting, not this view's state, so it is not a marker part either).

**Screenshots** (examples/app-crm, Accounts, `?uf__sort=[name desc]&uf__search=a` opened as a link, then the reset, then a reload). The 16 files are in the project files under `issue-28950/shots/` (`before-` and `after-`, `1440-` and `390-`):

| | before (main dedc3505) | after (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| 1440, personalized link | no sign the list differs; ⋯ holds only "Add to favorites" (no stored entry, so "Reset view" was never offered) | **Personalized** pill beside the view name; popover names Search and Sort |
| 1440, Display popover | "Reset to view default" footer | no whole-Display reset; the Open records, Group, Density, Row numbers and Edit inline controls stay |
| 390, personalized link | nothing | icon-only marker beside the phone title, same popover |
| after **Reset to view** | n/a | list back to the view's sort, search empty, address bar has no query; after a reload still none, marker gone (1440 and 390) |

## Verification

Readings at b2d090d8 (merge of main dedc3505, which carries #29047 and #29108 as ea150b7f):

- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check` for plugin-list, app-shell and i18n with dependencies: 67/67.
- `pnpm build` (whole workspace): 117/117.
- vitest from `ui/`: plugin-list 183 files, 1759 passed; app-shell `ObjectView*` / `objectView*` set 88 files, 735 passed (351 + 384); i18n 95 files, 1443 passed, 13 skipped; the two new files plus 12418, 37 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 66 derived families, all run, all exit 0 (includes `check-sdui-manifest` and `vitest run scripts/`).
- PR-body gates with this body: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword` all exit 0.
- ui eslint on the touched files: 0 errors.
- Live run (app-crm + console dev server): the reset leaves `location.search` empty and a reload keeps it empty at 1440 and 390 px.
